properties.name: District 4 or District 5
properties.note: The county's 2011 plan lists these blocks with the Central 6 precinct and puts them in District 5, but the census places them in Central 3, and the county's election results count Central 3 wholly in District 4. This map cannot yet say which is right.

Five single-member districts drawn from the county's 2011 apportionment plan, which lists each district as whole 2010 precincts plus named census blocks. The plan was adopted for the 2012 to 2020 elections. The county's 2022 and 2024 election results divide the same four precincts between the same districts, which is why these lines are taken as the ones in use. Populations exclude the 1,536 people of the federal prison in Greenville, as the plan does. Shared: a part of Greenville (District 4 or District 5).
properties.source: Census 2010 voting districts and blocks, composed per Bond County Board Resolution 06-27-11-01 (the county's apportionment plan, approved 27 June 2011), sent by County Clerk Brooke Weathers on 26 October 2026
